title: Anchor Settle Time After Drop
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mooring:status state=anchored
| stats avg(settle_min) as avg_settle_min, perc90(settle_min) as p90_settle_min, count as drops by anchorage
| sort - avg_settle_min
description: Tracks how long anchor setups usually take to settle and look trustworthy.
value: Long settle times can hint at poor bottoms, rushed technique, or weather that deserves more caution.
implementation: Send anchor-watch status changes to `index=personal`; compare settle times by anchorage.
visualization: Anchorage table of average and p90 anchor-settle minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how long it usually takes an anchor setup to settle properly after you drop it.
